key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual over months to years. LOCATION: Diffuse chest. DURATION: Chronic, progressive. CHARACTER: Progressive dyspnea, chest pain. AGGRAVATING: Exertion, lying flat. RELIEVING: Oxygen, vasodilators. TIMING: Chronic, progressive. SEVERITY: Moderate to severe (5-8/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Progressive dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue, syncope, leg swelling. KEY POSITIVES: Progressive dyspnea, chest pain, fatigue. KEY NEGATIVES: No fever, no wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).
